scope.purpose: Lock the definition of fluidity φ as a protocol+window+decision-function dependent failure rate; prevent ambiguous use as a free material constant.

symbols.P: Driving/observation protocol (construction rules for J_n and sampling)
symbols.W: Observation window [t0, t0+Δt] or equivalently N_total steps
symbols.N_total: Number of observations/updates in the window W
symbols.N_unjam: Count of steps classified as unjammed (chi_ST=0)

protocol_lock.comparability_note: φ values are only comparable when these fields match (same P and same W).
